grammar_title: 限制性定语从句:关系代词 who/whom/which/that、whose、介词+which/whom、关系副词 where/when/why
source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 1 Discovering Useful Structures:限制性定语从句。句子地道、答案唯一(看从句缺什么成分:缺主/宾→who/which/that;不缺主宾、缺状语→where/when/why 或 介词+which)。

points.overview: 先行词指人。从句缺主语用 who;从句缺宾语用 whom(尤其介词后、或正式书面)。
先行词指物、从句缺主语或宾语,用 which 或 that;that 不能用于介词后,不能引导非限制性从句。

points.point: 介词+which/whom · whose · 关系副词 where/when/why
points.overview: 从句不缺主宾、只缺状语:地点用 where、时间用 when、原因用 why,或用「介词+which/whom」;表所属用 whose。

questions.stem: The archaeologist ____ found the ancient relics became famous all over the world.
questions.explanation: 先行词 archaeologist 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The engineers ____ moved the first temple came from Germany.
questions.explanation: 先行词 engineers 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: She is the scientist to ____ the government turned for advice about the dam.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom(to whom)。

questions.stem: The volunteers ____ we met at the temple were taking photos of the relics.
questions.explanation: 先行词 volunteers 指人、从句缺宾语(met ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The reporter ____ wrote the news report visited Mount Tai last summer.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reporter 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: He is a guide ____ knows everything about the Forbidden City.
questions.explanation: 先行词 guide 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The old people ____ the students interviewed shared many local traditions.
questions.explanation: 先行词 old people 指人、从句缺宾语(interviewed ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: The expert from ____ we learned the building process was very patient.
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指人 → whom(from whom)。

questions.stem: The teacher ____ takes photos of old houses wants to preserve the city's heritage.
questions.explanation: 先行词 teacher 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The citizens ____ lived near the dam were worried about the temples.
questions.explanation: 先行词 citizens 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The workers ____ the project hired came from many different countries.
questions.explanation: 先行词 workers 指人、从句缺宾语(hired ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: She is the kind of researcher with ____ everyone enjoys working.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom(with whom)。

questions.stem: The man ____ designed the new museum studied ancient architecture for years.
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The students ____ joined the youth camp created an app about Mount Tai.
questions.explanation: 先行词 students 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The friends ____ I invited to the heritage site enjoyed the visit very much.
questions.explanation: 先行词 friends 指人、从句缺宾语(invited ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: She is the official to ____ the proposal was finally sent.
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom(to whom)。

questions.stem: The director ____ leads the team has saved many cultural relics.
questions.explanation: 先行词 director 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The local teenagers ____ visited the camp learned a lot about their history.
questions.explanation: 先行词 teenagers 指人、从句缺主语 → who。

questions.stem: The tour guide ____ the tourists thanked smiled and waved goodbye.
questions.explanation: 先行词 tour guide 指人、从句缺宾语(thanked ___)→ whom。

questions.stem: He is the only person on ____ the whole rescue plan depended.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指人 → whom(on whom)。

questions.stem: The temples ____ were moved to higher ground are now safe from the water.
questions.explanation: 先行词 temples 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: This is the app ____ introduces Mount Tai to young people.
questions.explanation: 先行词 app 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: The cultural relics ____ the workers rescued are kept in a safe place.
questions.explanation: 先行词 relics 指物、从句缺宾语(rescued ___)→ which。

questions.stem: The dam ____ the government planned would have flooded the valley.
questions.explanation: 先行词 dam 指物、从句缺宾语(planned ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The document ____ was signed in 1960 started the whole project.
questions.explanation: 先行词 document 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The photos ____ they took show the caves in great detail.
questions.explanation: 先行词 photos 指物、从句缺宾语(took ___)→ that。

questions.stem: It was a challenge ____ no single country could solve alone.
questions.explanation: 先行词 challenge 指物、从句缺宾语(solve ___)→ which。

questions.stem: The programme ____ prevents heritage sites from disappearing is run by UNESCO.
questions.explanation: 先行词 programme 指物、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: The pyramid ____ stands near the river attracts visitors from everywhere.
questions.explanation: 先行词 pyramid 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The fund ____ they raised paid for moving the ancient temples.
questions.explanation: 先行词 fund 指物、从句缺宾语(raised ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The caves ____ lie along the old Silk Road are part of world history.
questions.explanation: 先行词 caves 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The plan ____ the experts suggested saved the buildings from the flood.
questions.explanation: 先行词 plan 指物、从句缺宾语(suggested ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The mirror ____ hangs in the palace is said to tell right from wrong.
questions.explanation: 先行词 mirror 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The traditions ____ a country keeps are an important part of its heritage.
questions.explanation: 先行词 traditions 指物、从句缺宾语(keeps ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The wall ____ runs across the mountains is one of the great wonders of the world.
questions.explanation: 先行词 wall 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The images ____ the researchers collected are now shared on the Internet.
questions.explanation: 先行词 images 指物、从句缺宾语(collected ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The proposal ____ led to so many protests was finally changed.
questions.explanation: 先行词 proposal 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The carving ____ you can see on the roof is called chiwen.
questions.explanation: 先行词 carving 指物、从句缺宾语(see ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The committee ____ was established raised funds for the rescue work.
questions.explanation: 先行词 committee 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: The old houses ____ the photographer recorded are slowly disappearing.
questions.explanation: 先行词 houses 指物、从句缺宾语(recorded ___)→ that。

questions.stem: The temples were moved to a place ____ they were safe from the water.
questions.explanation: 先行词 place 表地点、从句不缺主宾(只缺地点状语)→ where。

questions.stem: I will never forget the day ____ the rescue project finally ended.
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Nobody could fully explain the reason ____ so many countries offered help.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: She is the writer ____ book about cultural heritage won a big prize.
questions.explanation: 表所属(她的书)→ whose。

questions.stem: An exit is the door through ____ you can leave a building.
questions.explanation: 介词 through 后指物 → which(through which)。

questions.stem: Dunhuang is the city ____ the famous Mogao Caves are found.
questions.explanation: 先行词 city 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: There may come a time ____ these old traditions disappear forever.
questions.explanation: 先行词 time 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: We met the archaeologist ____ knowledge of the pyramid amazed us all.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他的知识)→ whose。

questions.stem: The way in ____ the temples were saved became a model for the world.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指物 → which(in which)。

questions.stem: This is the museum ____ ancient bones and relics are carefully kept.
questions.explanation: 先行词 museum 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: 1980 was the year ____ the Aswan Dam project was finally completed.
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: He is the engineer ____ team moved twenty-two temples in twenty years.
questions.explanation: 表所属(他的团队)→ whose。

questions.stem: Calligraphy is an art form by ____ the past and present are connected.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后指物 → which(by which)。

questions.stem: Mount Tai is the mountain ____ thousands of carvings have been studied.
questions.explanation: 先行词 mountain 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: I still remember the moment ____ the first temple was lifted into place.
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: She is the volunteer ____ photos of old buildings are kept in the museum.
questions.explanation: 表所属(她的照片)→ whose。

questions.stem: These are the tools with ____ the workers took the temple apart.
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指物 → which(with which)。

questions.stem: Egypt is the country ____ the world's most famous pyramids stand.
questions.explanation: 先行词 country 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: That was the year ____ fifty countries donated money to the project.
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: Please tell me the reason ____ the old palace was rebuilt so carefully.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。
